summary: Orange Beach police booked two women on organized retail theft charges, sheriff's deputies booked a 57-year-old woman on a first-degree elder financial exploitation charge, and a judge set a $114,500 bond for Foley drug trafficking suspect Arvia Lloyd Allen. The jail roster shows 18 criminal bookings dated Nov. 9 and one so far on Nov. 10.

entries.title: Drug trafficking case, bond set: Arvia Lloyd Allen
body: District Judge Grant Blackburn set bond at $114,500 on all charges against Arvia Lloyd Allen, 36, at a court appearance Monday, Nov. 9, WKRG reported. Allen was arrested Friday, Nov. 6, at a home in Foley, where investigators spent several hours and removed evidence, according to the station.

WKRG reported the charges include drug trafficking involving cocaine, methamphetamine, marijuana and Xanax. The jail roster lists six booked charges, including drug trafficking and being a drunk or drug addict in possession of a firearm. He was in custody when the roster was read early Tuesday.

entries.title: Daphne solicitation operation: former Fairhope officer among 12 charged
body: One of the 12 men charged in a Daphne police operation on Friday, Nov. 6, is Jonathan Fender, a former Fairhope police officer, Daphne police said, according to FOX10. The Fairhope Police Department told the station Fender left the department in February for a private-sector job.

Police said the multi-agency operation targeted people trying to buy sex along the Interstate 10 corridor. All 12 men face solicitation charges, and three face other charges, including attempting to elude, resisting arrest and marijuana possession, FOX10 reported. Investigators said no actual victims were involved in the sting.

entries.title: Organized retail theft arrests: Julia Ann Gregg, Tiffany Lynne Marksberry
body: Orange Beach police arrested Julia Ann Gregg, 43, and Tiffany Lynne Marksberry, 39, at 8:58 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, according to the jail roster, which shows both booked Nov. 9. Both were in custody when the roster was read early Tuesday.
Each was booked on a charge of organized retail theft — stealing merchandise from stores to resell. The roster gives no further details.

entries.title: Elder exploitation arrest: Charlene Sue Moorere
body: Sheriff's deputies booked Charlene Sue Moorere, 57, into the county jail on Monday, Nov. 9, according to the jail roster, which gives an arrest stamp of 5:20 p.m. Nov. 2. She was in custody when the roster was read early Tuesday.

She was booked on a charge of first-degree financial exploitation of an elderly person — taking or misusing an older person's money or property. Deputies booked two other people on the same charge Nov. 8; the roster does not say whether the cases are connected.

entries.title: Attempting-to-elude arrests: Aaron Steven Wright, Jaden Tymerius Williams
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Aaron Steven Wright, 54, at 9:55 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9, according to the jail roster. Bay Minette police arrested Jaden Tymerius Williams, 21, who was booked Nov. 9 with an arrest stamp of 3:56 a.m. Nov. 10. Both were in custody when the roster was read.

Each was booked on a charge of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — fleeing from police after a signal to stop. Wright was also booked on three counts of violating a release order, and Williams on a release-order violation and a failure-to-appear charge. The roster does not connect the two arrests.

entries.title: Beach-town drug arrests: Stanley Kyle Wilson, Natravious Tavon Saffold, Lamycal Decree Mitchell
body: Orange Beach police arrested Stanley Kyle Wilson, 42, early Monday, Nov. 9, on charges of drunk driving, improper lane usage, possession of dangerous drugs and drug paraphernalia, according to the jail roster.

Gulf Shores police booked Natravious Tavon Saffold, 23, on marijuana possession and drug paraphernalia charges, and Lamycal Decree Mitchell, 20, on second-degree marijuana possession, drug paraphernalia and possession of a synthetic narcotic — a lab-made drug such as synthetic cannabinoids. All three were booked Nov. 9 and released the same day, the roster shows.

entries.title: Elder exploitation arrests: John Bruce McNider, Angel Tanya McNider
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested John Bruce McNider, 56, at 8:45 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, and Angel Tanya McNider, 54, the same day, according to the jail roster. Both were released Nov. 9, the roster shows.

Each was booked on three counts of first-degree financial exploitation of an elderly person — taking or misusing an older person's money or property — plus first-degree electronic stalking, repeated electronic contact meant to threaten or alarm, and theft. The roster gives no further details.

entries.title: Attempting-to-elude arrest: Anttwon Thornton
body: Bay Minette police arrested Anttwon Thornton, 67, at 9:45 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, according to the jail roster. He was released Nov. 9, the roster shows.
He was booked on charges of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — fleeing from police after a signal to stop — resisting arrest and obstructing governmental operations.

entries.title: Organized retail theft arrest: Jerrell Anay Edwards
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Jerrell Anay Edwards, 30, at 1:29 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read early Tuesday.

He was booked on charges of organized retail theft — stealing merchandise from stores to resell — failure to appear on a felony charge, and being a fugitive from justice, a hold for another jurisdiction.

entries.title: Family assault and harassment arrests: Alex Carden Turner, Debra Ann Fialek
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Alex Carden Turner, 51, at 9:22 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, and Debra Ann Fialek, 50, at 6:27 p.m., according to the jail roster. Both were released Nov. 9, the roster shows.

Turner was booked on a charge of simple assault on a family member — an assault on a family or household member. Fialek was booked on charges of harassment of a family member, public intoxication and second-degree marijuana possession. The roster does not connect the two arrests.

entries.title: Sheriff's arrests Nov. 8: Robert Christopher Clausell, Jay Kurelko, Shannon Marie Wheeler
body: Sheriff's deputies booked Robert Christopher Clausell, 42, at 8:04 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, on a reckless endangerment charge — conduct creating a serious risk of injury to another person. He was released the same day, the roster shows.

Deputies also booked Jay Kurelko, 37, on Nov. 8 on charges of possessing dangerous drugs, second-degree marijuana possession and drug paraphernalia; he was in custody when the roster was read early Tuesday. Shannon Marie Wheeler, 45, arrested at 5:50 p.m. Nov. 7 and booked Nov. 8, was booked on a drunk-driving charge and released Nov. 8.

entries.title: Attempting-to-elude arrest: Paul Ray Morris Jr.
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Paul Ray Morris Jr., 47, at 1:25 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, according to the jail roster. He was in custody when the roster was read.
He was booked on a charge of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — fleeing from police after a signal to stop.
